text:
incident-bot: P0 alert: gpu-pool us-east-2 at 100% utilization, request backlog > 2 minutes for 7 minutes. Autoscaler failed to scale: provider responded with 429/403 errors.

sam (oncall): I'm taking this. p95 for completion >20s. marking as customer impacting for Hosted in us-east-2.

rita (infra): pulling autoscaler logs now. seeing repeated `LimitExceeded` and `TooManyRequests` from provider API. controller attempted 5 scale ops and then entered crash-loop due to panic in attach-handler.

omar (sre): any global throttles firing? want to prevent cascading retries.

hana (runtime): gateway shows large queue depth, and our batching causes big token spikes. also healthchecks show new nodes stuck in `Init` because driver module failed to load on boot on some kernels.

sam (oncall): immediate plan: 1) pause scheduled batch/eval jobs (low priority); 2) shift enterprise traffic to other regions (us-west-1 failover); 3) try manual attach of reserved standby nodes if possible.

lucy (cs): got a support escalation from an SMB customer with repeated 504s. flagging to engage once mitigations in.

rita (infra): attempting manual attach of 4 standby GPUs. note: cloud API denies normal autoscale requests (429), but we can attach customer-reserved nodes. starting attach now.

incident-bot: manual attach initiated by rita at 1834568012.

hana (runtime): will also temporarily decrease router max_concurrency for `standard` tier from 1000 to 200 and increase for `enterprise` to preserve SLA. applying now.

omar (sre): enabling `early_reject` for requests queued >75s and lowering background route weights. posting metrics snapshot.

rita (infra): attach succeeded for 3/4 nodes; 1 failed with `driver-init-timeout`. new nodes registering; scheduler placing workloads.

sam (oncall): queue length down ~40% and p95 latency improving. good sign. keep monitoring for at least 30m.

lucy (cs): I sent a status update to affected customers: "We are aware of interruptions in us-east-2; mitigations in progress; next update in 20m."

hana (runtime): investigating attach-handler panic: stack shows nil-ref when parsing provider error body that is plain text (not json). PR created: runtime#2567 "guard provider error parsing". Also adding retry with exponential backoff on 429/503.

rita (infra): opened cloud ticket CLD-9912 with provider. they acknowledge throttling due to region-level API limits; suggest quota request but ETA ~48h. asking for temporary increased rate-limits for our account.

omar (sre): capturing metrics for postmortem: queue_seconds_by_tier, attach_error_rate, autoscaler_restarts, provider_429_count. snapshotting dashboards.

sam (oncall): handoff: I'll stay another 20m then hand to rita for overnight follow-up. hana/omar stay to monitor the hotfix.

hana (runtime): action items: add metric `autoscaler_provider_429` + alert; extend autoscaler to fallback to reserved attach path when provider 429/403 seen; land PR #2567 and #2568 (retry/backoff) and run e2e simulating provider throttling.

rita (infra): action items: document manual attach runbook, automate standby attach via infra job, request provider rate-limit increase (CLD-9912). create infra ticket INF-1402 for standby automation.

omar (sre): action items: add alert for queue>60s for >5m, add dashboard panel for attach success/failure, schedule postmortem within 72h. will own the postmortem doc.

lucy (cs): action items: compile affected customer list and timeline, draft customer comms, propose credits for severe impact.

sam (oncall): summary: root causes = provider API throttling + autoscaler not resilient to unexpected provider error formats + intermittent driver init failures; impact = queue growth and elevated latencies in us-east-2 affecting hosted and fallback dedicated customers; mitigations = manual attach of reserved nodes, router priorities, pausing background jobs, hotfix PRs in flight.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and marked resolved by sam. Duration ~12m to primary mitigation, full recovery ~25m. Severity: P1.

ahana (runtime): note: include PR references #2567, #2568, and #2570 (add metric) in postmortem. Also include test harness that simulates cloud 429/403 responses.

omar (sre): scheduling retro and postmortem write-up. owners and ETAs will be added to doc. recommend cross-team retro with infra/runtime within 48h.

lucy (cs): will join postmortem to present customer impact; will coordinate compensation asks.

sam (oncall): thanks team. I'll open the postmortem skeleton and assign owners. If anything flares up re-open this thread. :raised_hands:
